name: Figure 03
summary: Figure 03 is Figure AI’s third-generation general-purpose humanoid robot, succeeding the retired Figure 02. Manufacturer-reported specifications include a 20 kg payload, 1.2 m/s speed and five-hour runtime, with measurement conditions unspecified. Figure has documented the robot’s arrival at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg. General purchase availability and public pricing remain unconfirmed.
specs_note: Commercial maturity PILOT recorded 2026-10-04 (owner decision, six-robot review). Basis: Figure 03 placed at an external customer site and a customer deployment agreement; no purchase or general availability is stated. Figure 03 is a separate, unpublished successor-generation robot to Figure 02 (figure-02); it is not merged with it. SPECIFICATIONS (owner-approved promotion batch 1, 2026-10-19): height, weight, payload, runtime and speed come from the stat block of Figure's official product page https://www.figure.ai/figure, captured on 2026-10-18 by HumanoidOnline's automated discovery observation of the owner-authorized source figure-ai-official (docs/28 A4; adapter 0.2.0) and stored as discovery claims (height 48923025, weight bd4d27ae, payload b4da6ae2, runtime c3258260, speed 6e17a216). Weight, payload, runtime and speed are recorded as stated (61KG, 20KG, 5HR, 1.2M/S); height is stated as 5'8" and recorded as approximately 173 cm. Automated capture, not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading; not independently verified.
